title: Pure Argostars
summary: Argostars cards only, with generic staples; the page's Fiendsmith buffer is left out. Argostars - Glorious Adra is the Normal Summon: it banishes itself to place two Argostars Continuous Traps face-up from the Deck, and the turn it is summoned the opponent cannot respond to them. The Traps summon themselves as Level 4 Warriors, and Lightning Tydeu searches on the way, so every turn ends in a Rank 4. Argostars - Fierce Parthe recycles a Trap to summon itself, Argostars - Giantslaying grants a second Warrior Normal Summon, and Adventurous Arion, the newest card, searches a Spell and puts three Traps back from the GY. Macro Cosmos is the one generic extra: everything sent to the GY is banished, which feeds Home Stadium and Slayer Eteo.
main: Starter: banishes itself to place two Argostars Continuous Traps from the Deck.
Quick Effect: returns an Argostars Trap to the hand to summon itself; banishes itself to Set a Trap.
Quick-Play: searches an Argostars monster and grants an extra Warrior Normal Summon.
Field Spell: recovers Argostars from the GY or banishment and negates a card.
Discards to summon itself and searches any Argostars card.
Summons itself when they activate and bounces a card.
Summons itself next to another Trap monster; keeps Warriors from being destroyed by battle.
Generic Continuous Trap: everything sent to the GY is banished, which the Argostars recover from.
extra: Newest card: Rank 4 that searches an Argostars Spell and replaces three Traps from the GY.
Rank 4: Quick Effect attaches the top card of opponent's Deck as material and detaches for draw, banish, or bounce disruption.

allow.Time Thief Redoer: Rank 4 staple boss providing non-destruction removal and disruption on the opponent's turn.
